scope: Integrity and retained-member index for original GitHub native model artifact ZIPs; no independent phase acceptance is claimed here.
integrity_checks: Original ZIP byte count and SHA-256 match retained GitHub artifact metadata.
ZIP CRCs pass; member names are unique, relative and free of traversal/backslash/drive aliases.
Members are ordinary files or directories; no symlink or other special member types are accepted.
Each ZIP has fewer than 1000 members, each file is at most 16 MiB, and expanded size is below 256 MiB.
Every indexed member body equals its original ZIP member and the corresponding downloaded extraction.
Fresh configuration stamps match both before/after report identities; old missing stamps are not reconstructed.
Final successful hosted jobs are matched to each fresh variant and exact source revision.
limitations: Archive integrity is separate from independent numerical, dispatch, source/compiler provenance and phase acceptance review.
The four earlier f4c6a3 packets retain their missing-stamp failure and are excluded from fresh qualification totals.
job.json and preparation.json retain their initial native_execution=not_run fields; final report, raw command logs and final hosted job establish finished outcomes.
Native binary, complete external dependency, toolchain, system header and dynamic-library bodies are not archived; hashes and bounded source identities do not form a binary replay archive.
Auditor replay checks retained evidence and requires the exact main-repository Git objects; it does not execute the native workload.
Native processor RTL scope excludes AFU, vendor hw_emu, physical FPGA and silicon measurement.
